clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements regarding material, sizes, construction, workmanship, finish, inspection and testing of timber door shutters with timber, plywood, blockboard, veneered particle board, asbestos  cement sheet, wire guage and glass panels used in domestic buildings, offices, schools, hospitals, etc. The shutters could be single panelled or multipanelled with or without glazing. This standard does not cover timber door shutters for industrial and other special buildings,  such as, workshops and garages.

clauses.title: Timber
clauses.text: 2. Timber —Timber suitable for manufacture of door shutters shall be in accordance with IS 12896 : 1990.*

clauses.title: Timber used for rails
clauses.text: 2.1 Timber used for rails and stiles shall be of the same species. The maximum permissible moisture content in timber shall be as specified in IS 287 : 1993+.

clauses.title: All timbers shall be kiln
clauses.text: 2.2 All timbers shall be kiln-seasoned. Sapwood of durable species and heartwood and sapwood of nondurable species shall be treated with suitable preservative (except the water soluble leachable type). as specified in IS 401‡

clauses.title: The timber shall be
clauses.text: 2.3 The timber shall be free from decay, fungal growth, boxed heart, splits, pitch pockets or streaks on the exposed faces.

clauses.title: The timber shall be
clauses.text: 2.4 The timber shall be graded as First Grade and Second Grade on the basis of the permissible defects in the timber as given in Table 1 of the standard. Note: For details of material see 5 of the  standard.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 3. Requirements

clauses.title: Timber Panelling
clauses.text: 3.1 Timber Panelling — No single panel shall exceed 0.5m2 in area.

clauses.title: Plywood Panelling
clauses.text: 3.2 Plywood Panelling — Shall be of one piece of thickness not less than 9 mm for 2 or more panel construction and 12 mm for single panel construction.

clauses.title: Blockboard Panelling
clauses.text: 3.3 Blockboard Panelling — Shall be of one piece of thickness 12 mm or more.

clauses.title: Veneered Particle Board Panelling
clauses.text: 3.4 Veneered Particle Board Panelling — Shall be made of one piece of veneered particle board. Thickness shall not be less than 12 mm.

clauses.title: Asbestos Cement Board Panelling
clauses.text: 3.5 Asbestos Cement Board Panelling — Shall consist of two or more panels with thickness of each panel not less than 6 mm.

clauses.title: Medium Density Fibre Board Panelling
clauses.text: 3.6 Medium Density Fibre Board Panelling— Thickness of boards shall not be less than 12 mm.

clauses.title: Prelaminated Particles Board Panelling
clauses.text: 3.7 Prelaminated Particles Board Panelling— Thickness of boards shall not be less than 12 mm.

clauses.title: Wire Gauze Panelleing –
clauses.text: 3.8  Wire Gauze Panelleing - Shall be so designated that no single panel exceeds 0.5 m2 in are

clauses.title: Medium Density Wood Particle
clauses.text: 3.9  Medium Density Wood Particle Board Panelling - shall be made of one piece of medium density wood particle board. Thicknes of boards used shall not be less than 12 mm.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 4.3 Tolerances — Tolerances on the sizes of door shutters shall be  ± 3 mm.

clauses.title: Finish
clauses.text: 5 Finish

clauses.title: All door shutters shall
clauses.text: 5.1 All door shutters shall be sanded and finished smooth.

clauses.title: Panels of shutters shall
clauses.text: 5.2 Panels of shutters shall be flat and well sanded to a smooth and level surface.

clauses.title: Defective knots, when permitted on surfaces
clauses.text: 5.3 Defective knots, when permitted on surfaces exposed to view shall be completely bored or cut out and tightly plugged with the same timber species and properly glued in. The grains of the plug shall run in direction of the grains of the piece.

clauses.title: All the surface of
clauses.text: 5.4 All the surface of door shutters which are required to be painted or polished or varnished ultimately shall be covered initially before delivery by protective coat of primer polish or varnish. As specified in IS 2338 (Part 1)* and IS 2338 (Part 2)+.

clauses.title: Glazing –
clauses.text: 6. Glazing -

clauses.title: The glass used for
clauses.text: 6.1 The glass used for panels shall be weighing not less than 10 kg/m2 and the thickness shall not be less than 4mm.

clauses.title: Tests
clauses.text: 7. Tests — Door shutters shall be subjected to following tests as specified : (i) Dimensions and defects for squareness (ii) General flatness (iii) Local planeness (iv) Impact intendation (v) Flexure (vi) Edge loading (vii) Shock resistance (viii) Buckling (ix) Misuse (x) Slamming, and (xi) Screw withdrawal resistance. For detailed information,refer to IS   1003 (Part 1) : 2003  Specification  for timber panelled and glazed shutter: Part1 door shutters (fourth revision). *Code of practice for finishing of wood and wood based materials: Part 1 Operations and workmanship + Code of practice for finishing of wood and wood based materials: Part 2 Schedules
